projects.title: Student Volunteer Army
projects.description: When the Christchurch earthquakes struck, Sam used Facebook to mobilise students into a coordinated volunteer force, clearing thousands of tonnes of liquefaction silt from the city's streets and homes. The SVA has since grown into a national movement with school, tertiary and community programmes that put young people at the heart of civic service.

projects.title: 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami
projects.description: Sam's first international deployment — supporting volunteer coordination in the aftermath of the Tōhoku disaster and testing the SVA model beyond New Zealand.

projects.title: Cyclone Pam & Nepal earthquake responses
projects.description: Back-to-back disaster deployments focused on volunteer mobilisation and community resilience in two very different contexts.

projects.title: Global youth leadership advocacy
projects.description: Programme design, advisory work and keynotes that have influenced school students, boardrooms and politicians across three continents.
